discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis)
rationale: Sequencing by synthesis with reversible-terminator chemistry and cluster amplification cut genome sequencing costs by orders of magnitude and transformed biology and medicine. It is a chemical invention, it has already won the Breakthrough Prize (2022) and the Millennium Technology Prize (2020), and it fits the committee's habit of honoring chemistry that enables life science. Recent prizes went to protein design (2024) and MOFs (2025), so an analytical or biochemical method is a plausible next choice.
